title: Payment: Charge requests failing
symptoms: `oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge` returns errors; checkout `PlaceOrder` fails with "failed to charge card"; the frontend returns 500 on `POST /api/checkout`; orders per minute drop.
check: 1. In traces, filter payment Charge spans with status ERROR. Note the error message and the `app.loyalty.level` attribute: failures limited to one loyalty level point to the `paymentFailure` feature flag, not the card processor. 2. Open the flagd UI and read the `paymentFailure` value (0 = off; 0.5 = half of charges fail).
mitigate: Set `paymentFailure` to `off` in flagd. If the flag is already off, roll back the last payment deploy. Charge errors should fall below 5% within 5 minutes.
escalate: Payments team on-call if errors persist 15 minutes after mitigation.

title: Ad service: high CPU and slow GetAds
symptoms: The ad container runs near its CPU limit and is throttled; `GetAds` p95 latency rises; GetAds returns DEADLINE_EXCEEDED; the frontend ad banner times out.
check: 1. Compare ad CPU to its limit and look for throttled periods. 2. Read the ad service log for "High CPU-Load problempattern"; it means the `adHighCpu` flag is on.
mitigate: Set `adHighCpu` to `off` in flagd. Otherwise scale the ad deployment out by one replica. Ads are not on the checkout path, so this is not a revenue emergency.

title: Recommendation: memory growth and cache failure
symptoms: Recommendation memory grows steadily toward its limit; `app.cache_size` keeps rising while the cache hit ratio is near zero; ListRecommendations slows down; the container is OOMKilled (exit 137) and restarts.
check: 1. Plot `app.cache_size` against container memory. Growth without hits means the cache is never read back, which is what the `recommendationCacheFailure` flag does. 2. Count restarts with reason OOMKilled in the last hour.
mitigate: Set `recommendationCacheFailure` to `off` in flagd, then restart the recommendation deployment to free the memory. Do not raise the memory limit; it only delays the next OOM kill.
escalate: Recommendations team on-call if memory keeps growing after the restart.

title: Product catalog: GetProduct failing
symptoms: `oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct` returns errors; product pages return 500; checkout fails to prepare order items.
check: 1. Group GetProduct failures by `app.product.id`. Failures for a single product id with the message "Product Catalog Fail Feature Flag Enabled" mean the `productCatalogFailure` flag is on. 2. If failures span many product ids, check the catalog data file was loaded at startup.
mitigate: Set `productCatalogFailure` to `off` in flagd. For many-product failures, restart product-catalog to reload the catalog.

title: Cart: Valkey errors and EmptyCart failures
symptoms: Cart `AddItem`, `GetCart` or `EmptyCart` fail; the cart page shows an empty cart; the cart service logs Valkey connection errors.
check: 1. Check that the valkey-cart container is running and reachable from cart. 2. Read the `cartFailure` flag in flagd; when on, EmptyCart fails on purpose.
mitigate: Set `cartFailure` to `off`. Restart valkey-cart if it is down; carts are not persisted, so shoppers lose their carts.

title: Currency: conversion errors
symptoms: `Convert` or `GetSupportedCurrencies` fail; prices show as 0 or the frontend shows a currency error.
check: Read the currency service log for unsupported currency codes and confirm the exchange-rate table loaded at startup.
mitigate: Restart the currency service. Roll back the last deploy if errors continue.

title: Shipping: quote and ShipOrder failures
symptoms: `GetQuote` or `ShipOrder` fail or slow down; checkout shows no shipping cost.
check: Check the shipping service's calls to the quote service and their latency.
mitigate: Restart quote, then shipping. If quote is slow, scale it out by one replica.

title: Email: order confirmations not sent
symptoms: `send_order_confirmation` calls fail or slow down; email memory grows.
check: Read the `emailMemoryLeak` flag in flagd and the email container's memory trend.
mitigate: Set `emailMemoryLeak` to `off` and restart the email service. Confirmations are not retried, so list the affected order ids for the support team.

title: Frontend proxy: 503s and upstream connect errors
symptoms: frontend-proxy (Envoy) returns 503 with "upstream connect error" for every route; the load generator reports connection failures.
check: Check that the frontend container is up and that Envoy's cluster health checks pass. Errors on only one API route point to the service behind that route, not to the proxy.

title: Feature flags: flagd unavailable
symptoms: Services log "flag evaluation failed" or fall back to default flag values; the flagd UI does not load.
check: Check that the flagd container is running and that `demo.flagd.json` is valid JSON.
mitigate: Restore the last good `demo.flagd.json` and restart flagd. Services pick up the flags again without a restart.
